messages:
nadia: noticed increase in transient SSE disconnects after yesterday’s proxy rollout (1.4.2). users see immediate reconnects ~500ms apart then a full drop.

kevin: I can repro locally with a small write pattern. looks like the newline heartbeat isn't getting flushed through consistently.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: 2026-03-20T21:04:12 - edge-proxy v1.4.2 -> canary group A (initiated by @ops-janet).

ops-janet: ops saw a small spike in 5xx from streaming endpoints at 21:06. paused further promotion.

telemetry: current console metric shows active_sse_sessions jumping then falling; sampling reveals many sessions <2s. our aggregation increments on socket_open and decrements on graceful_close only. abrupt TCP RSTs not always decrementing count.

ui-raul: that double-counting makes the dashboard chart look like a surge; can we surface a new "short-session" metric so alerts can be meaningful?

kevin: dug into proxy: commit altering small-write coalescing moved threshold from instant flush to 64 bytes batch window. For clients sending just "\n" as keepalive, the flush is delayed -> backend times out and closes. the proxy then emits RST.

nadia: tcpdump for one trace attached: sequence shows single 0a byte then FIN? then shortly RST. odd timing.

kevin: patch idea: when route is streaming (content-type text/event-stream or transfer-encoding chunked) treat small writes as immediate flush or lower the coalesce window. quicker to ship than a large refactor.

ops-janet: would prefer a config flag so we can toggle per-route while we validate. also need a canary rollback path.

telemetry: propose alert rule: rate(short_sse_sessions{env=canary}) / rate(short_sse_sessions{env=prod}) > 2 for 5m -> paging oncall. will add a dashboard comparator panel to show canary vs prod.

ui-raul: also want an annotation on the deployment timeline so product knows when to expect noise. add rollout tag on the dashboard.

kevin: wrote a unit + integration test that simulates a client sending one-byte newline every 300ms, ensures connection persists. also added route-level config and default to preserve previous behavior for known SSE routes. PR -> https://github.com/redwood/edge-proxy/pull/489

nadia: quick verification on canary with the flag enabled: reconnect loops disappear, session histogram stabilizes. ops: can you resume gradual rollout once PR merges?

ops-janet: will coordinate with release playbook. holding global rollout until hotfix deployed to canary and metrics look normal for 30m.

telemetry: implemented short-session metric and a heatmap. set alert to warn at 3x baseline and page at 6x. console will auto-tag the canary window.

kevin: follow-up: need to audit other places coalescing is used (websocket path too). might be similar for tiny ping frames over ws. adding a follow-up ticket.

ui-raul: noted. i'll add a dashboard panel for ws tiny-frames as well. thanks all. :thumbsup:
